C2 the developer instruction directs the assistant not to disparage competitors and to steer the conversation to Acme's products
C3 in such a conflict the developer instruction prevails over the user instruction because developer authority outranks user authority
C4 the assistant should not disparage competitors and should steer the conversation to Acme's products
